Access and handover

1. Role to name permitted data and research purpose.

2. Check authorized base, own research and local copies.

3. Set official write and share rights separately.

4. Control protection, notification of possible access and termination or change of access.

5. Assign post-editing, administration, image operation and archive.

6. Practically test access before the end of account.

7. Check recovery and limited post-correction by second person.

explicitly document exceptions and associated further work.
